tasks.short: Submit forms to the underwriter for binder coverage.

steps.what: Build the binder pack from the client file.

loop.output: Binder pack: insured, cover, dates, sums
loop.check: Agent checks each field against the application
loop.stop: One pass; a missing sum blocks submission
loop.why_not_simpler: Applications mix form fields and free-text conditions

steps.what: Contact the underwriter and submit the binder forms.
Decide whether to grant binder coverage.
Record the binder number and dates.
Tell the client the binder is in force.

tasks.design: The binder pack is filled from the {CRM} file and checked by the agent, who then contacts the underwriter. The underwriter's decision is their work. The client notice uses only the binder number and dates the agent recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packs were assembled from several documents, and the client was told by a separate retyping.
tasks.enabler_now: Insured, cover, dates and sums are fields, so a complete pack can be blocked when a sum is missing.
tasks.still_hard: The underwriter still asks questions that are not on the form.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which missing fact will make the underwriter refuse.

ambition.what: The agent decides before the call whether the binder pack is complete enough to submit.

tasks.altitude: The call stays. Incomplete packs are stopped before the underwriter sees them.

reach.task: Send a complete instruction pack to a third party
reach.learn: Which missing fields make them hold a pack

evidence.claim: A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.
Submitting a risk to an underwriter is an external send of client facts.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. The underwriter's decision is other people's time and is not saved here. Boundary: from a complete-enough file to a binder record and a client notice.
Structured fields are insured name, cover, start date, sum and binder number. The agent produces the pack; the underwriter produces the binder number. Fallback: a missing sum stops the submit.
Test {CRM} document templates before custom code. The underwriter's system is not the agent's hour.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the pack template.
unknowns: Whether binder requests already go through a portal rather than mail and a call.
Which sums the underwriter treats as mandatory.
research_questions: What share of binder calls are only to chase a missing field?
Does the client notice have to quote the binder number exactly?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the underwriter call stays long because risks are unusual. High case: complete packs make the call short, and the underwriter's own time is not counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select the company that will underwrite the coverage.

steps.what: List companies that offer the requested coverage.
Compare appetite, price band and exclusions.
Select the company that will underwrite the policy.
Tell the client which company was selected.

loop.input: Selected company and the reason code
loop.check: Agent checks the company name and that no price is invented
loop.stop: One draft; no reason code means no send
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason is a sentence, not only a code

tasks.design: The {CRM} lists companies that have the requested coverage code. Comparing appetite and exclusions, and selecting the company, stay with the agent. The {EMAIL} note uses the selection the agent made and does not invent a price.
tasks.previous_blocker: Market lists were personal spreadsheets, and the reason for a choice was not on the file.
tasks.enabler_now: Coverage code and a maintained appetite list let the first cut be a filter. The choice is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Appetite changes, and a refusal last month may not be on the list.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which insurer will actually write this risk.

ambition.what: The agent records the selected company and the reason on the day of the choice.

tasks.altitude: Selection stays the agent's decision. Less time goes to finding who even offers the cover.

reach.task: Choose a product that fits a site's limits
reach.learn: How they record why a product was rejected

evidence.claim: A market list can filter who offers a cover; the placement is still a judgement.
Life and health insurance pricing of natural persons is a high-risk use under the AI Act annex.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from a coverage request to a company told to the client. Negotiating terms is out of scope.

Structured fields are coverage code, company, appetite, exclusion and reason code. The agency maintains the list. Fallback: an unknown coverage code returns no companies and the agent searches by hand.
Test {CRM} company records before a custom list. Do not add a model that sets a life or health price.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours is appetite maintenance, which is new steady work.
unknowns: Whether appetite is maintained in the {CRM} or in a private sheet.
How many insurers this agency actually places with.
research_questions: What share of requests have a coverage code on the first day?
How often is the first-choice company refused later?

incremental.description: Maintain insurer appetite and exclusion notes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: appetite data is thin, so the comparison stays fully manual. High case: the list is current and only the choice and the note remain. No automated life or health price is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Chase policy requirements, including medical examinations and forms.

steps.what: List policy requirements that are still open.
Arrange the medical examination the policy requires.
Chase forms and the examination status.
Mark the requirements fulfilled on the policy.

tasks.design: The {CRM} lists open requirements. The agent arranges the medical examination; the examiner does the exam. Chase notes and the fulfilled flag use status only, not a diagnosis. The note waits for the agent's check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirement lists were kept beside the policy, and chase mail repeated the same blanks.
tasks.enabler_now: Requirement code and status are fields. A status of received can close the line without reading a diagnosis.
tasks.still_hard: Getting the client to attend, and forms that arrive incomplete.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which client needs a call rather than another mail.

ambition.what: The agent decides each morning which open requirement is late enough to call about.

tasks.altitude: Less time on the list. Calls about examinations stay. The agent does not read medical detail into the file.

reach.role: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
reach.task: Chase missing client documents before an application proceeds
reach.learn: Which document statuses they store without keeping the document body in the sales file

evidence.claim: The agent tracks whether a medical examination happened, and does not take the clinical decision.
A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. The examiner's time is supplier time and is not saved. Boundary: from open requirements to a fulfilled flag. Underwriting the result is out of scope.
Structured fields are requirement code, status, appointment date and received yes or no. The examiner produces status, not a diagnosis. Fallback: the agent types status from a mail.
Test {CRM} requirement checklists before custom code. Do not extract diagnosis text.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers checklist changes per product.
unknowns: Whether exam status already returns as a code from the examiner.
Which products require a medical examination.
research_questions: What share of requirements are forms rather than examinations?
How often does a form arrive incomplete?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: most files need a medical examination and several calls. High case: form-only files close from status codes. Diagnosis text is never a field.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a marketing strategy against other insurance sellers.

steps.what: Gather how competing sellers present their insurance.

loop.input: Competitor notes and own result extract
loop.output: Market notes with channel and claim
loop.check: Agent drops a claim that has no source note
loop.stop: One pass; no source means the line is deleted

steps.what: Draft a marketing strategy for this agency.

loop.check: Agent edits audience and offer before anyone else sees it
loop.stop: One draft; an offer with no product code is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: A strategy is prose, not a filter

steps.what: Decide which marketing strategy to run.
Brief colleagues on the chosen strategy.

tasks.design: Market notes are extracted only from material the agent already holds, and a strategy draft is edited by the agent. The choice and the briefing stay in the room. Nothing is published to customers from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competitor clippings and last quarter's numbers lived in different places, so the strategy was rewritten from scratch each time.
tasks.enabler_now: A short note with audience, channel and product code is enough to brief the team. Publishing ads is a later task.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a claim the agency can actually stand behind.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which competitor line their own clients already repeat.

ambition.what: A one-page strategy brief for colleagues who do not attend the planning meeting.

tasks.altitude: The planning meeting stays. The agent arrives with notes that cite a source, and can refuse a draft offer that has no product code.

reach.task: Choose which trips to feature against other sellers
reach.learn: How they keep a source next to a competitive claim

evidence.claim: A sales system can research leads and draft outreach mail.
A marketing claim about a policy still needs a person before it is used.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from gathered competitor notes to an internal brief. Buying ads and sending campaigns are out of scope.
Structured fields are competitor, channel, claim, source and product code. The agent produces the notes. Fallback: a line with no source is deleted.
Test {DOCS} pages before custom code. Do not send the draft outside the agency.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the brief template.
unknowns: Whether competitor notes are collected at all today.
Who else must agree before a strategy is briefed.
research_questions: How often is this strategy written down rather than only said?
Which channels does the agency actually use?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: competitor material is thin and the meeting builds the strategy from scratch. High case: notes and a draft exist, and the choice plus the briefing stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Underwriter calls, company choice, examination chasing and strategy meetings stay. Packs and open-requirement lists take less time. The agent can hold an incomplete binder pack or a chase note.
reach: Real estate brokers hold incomplete packs
Securities agents chase documents without storing the whole file in the sales note
skills_to_grow: Stopping a binder pack that has a blank sum
Recording exam status without a diagnosis
Writing a reason code next to a chosen insurer
role.ambitious_version: The agent spends placement time on risks an appetite list cannot settle, with packs and requirement lists already complete or clearly blocked.
